notes.title: Starbo News
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653402/700637398bb11d00a7196db30736c0e9b20aee87.jpg[/img]

[b]STARBO[/b] has been updated for the very first time, ever!
Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions! This first update include several bug-fixes, improvements and a bunch of added details to the game such as;
[list]
    [*]Automatic saving (in the Steam Cloud) & chapter selection (in the main menu).
    [*]A lot less strong, annoying, flickering lights!
    [*]Bug fixes.
    [*]& a whole bunch of other tiny, tiny details can now be found in the blue.
[/list]

[b]With Best Regards[/b]
David at Diax Game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653402/78c52832230e536e6152b6ebb671e5a5f5931ea2.jpg[/img]
